Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation SPRITE SHEET for Brainrot Battaglia arcade fighting game. Reference image 1 is the game's actual Saturnita sprite: MATCH ITS CARTOON pixel-art rendering, compact readable shapes, simple dark-purple contour, warm 48–64 colour palette, gold/cream/violet shading. Avoid realistic/painterly metal, ornate armour, texture noise and enormous head. This is her powered-up form with same recognisable banded round Saturn torso, white and brown cow face, golden horns, pink snout and a little glowing purple MEGA BRAIN held between her horns. Strong simple gauntlets and hooves, wide golden ring round the waist, small dark-violet cape. Powerful but visually belongs beside the reference sprite.
Exactly SIXTEEN whole-body sprites in a strict FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW grid, sixteen equal cells, one sprite per cell. All sprites face RIGHT and are the SAME character at the SAME body scale; foot baseline in each cell at 88% height, centre torso at 45% width. Generous transparent gutters, no figure or ring crosses a cell boundary. Orthographic side view, entire character and equipment visible.
Cells reading left to right, top to bottom:
0 idle fighting guard; 1 walk left-leg-forward; 2 walk passing stride with legs close; 3 real low crouch with knees bent and guard.
4 punch windup arm drawn back; 5 punch impact with fist extended far RIGHT; 6 punch recovery bent elbow returning.
7 kick windup with raised knee; 8 horizontal side-kick with hoof extended far RIGHT; 9 kick recovery bent knee.
10 special charge, arms gathering ring power near chest; 11 special release, palms thrust RIGHT, no projectile.
12 strong hit recoil toward LEFT; 13 knocked down lying horizontally, head RIGHT; 14 airborne jump knees tucked; 15 victorious raised fist and golden ring.
Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, 1-pixel dark outlines at target scale, consistent anatomy and lighting. No blur, gradients, photorealism, background, cast shadow, text, cell borders, frame numbers or watermark. Genuine transparent alpha around every sprite. Square sheet 1536x1536 or larger. The sheet must show all sixteen clearly distinct readable poses.

Strong athletic readable proportions, not an oversized chibi head, no realistic rendering, no intricate engraving. He is the powerful final playable hero, distinct from the cow.
Exactly SIXTEEN whole-body sprites in a strict FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW grid, sixteen equal cells, one sprite per cell.
